Goal

An archive contains N isolated chambers. Doors between chambers are opened and closed over time. You must answer whether two chambers are connected at particular moments.

The challenge is that doors can be removed, so a simple disjoint-set union (DSU) alone is not enough. Your program must answer every query in chronological order.

 Operations

Each operation is one of:

  • + id u v: open a door with identifier id between chambers u and v.
  • - id: close the currently open door with identifier id.
  • ? u v: answer whether u and v are connected using doors currently open.

Doors are undirected. Multiple doors may connect the same pair of chambers, and a chamber may have a door to itself. Every door identifier is unique across all additions. A removal always refers to a currently open door. Connectivity includes a chamber's connection to itself.

An addition or removal takes effect immediately, before the next operation. A query observes the state after all preceding operations and before any later operation.

 Example

5 9
+ 10 1 2
+ 11 2 3
? 1 3
- 10
? 1 3
+ 12 3 4
? 1 4
+ 13 1 2
? 1 4

Output:

YES
NO
NO
YES

After door 10 is closed, chambers 1 and 3 are disconnected. The later door 13 reconnects chambers 1 and 2. Since doors 11 and 12 remain open, chamber 4 is now connected to chamber 1 as well.

Input
Line 1: Two integers N and Q — the number of chambers and operations.
Next Q lines: One operation in one of the formats described above.
Output
For each ? u v operation, output YES if the chambers are connected, otherwise output NO, one answer per line.

 Constraints

  • 2 ≤ N ≤ 200,000
  • 1 ≤ Q ≤ 200,000
  • 1 ≤ u, v ≤ N
  • 1 ≤ id ≤ 109
  • All operations are valid according to the rules above.
  • At least one query is present.

Difficulty note

A solution that rebuilds connectivity after each update is too slow. Standard DSU cannot directly undo arbitrary unions. A high-performance solution processes active-time intervals offline, stores each interval in a segment tree over time, and traverses that tree with a rollback DSU.
